name: git-steward
description: Multi-repo git stewardship: branch pruning, commit & history hygiene, secret/large-file removal, repo health, work-item triage, and CI pipeline health — plus a fleet-wide CI watchdog that monitors every pipeline in every repo and autofixes failures (gated by default, autonomous per policy). Analyze (read-only) and apply (mutating) modes stack from a single operation to a single repo to the whole fleet.
